Welcome to Eddy County
Eddy County, ND, has a population of 2,368 people. Its 647 square miles contain the communities of New Rockford (the county seat) and Sheyenne, and the townships of Bush, Cherry Lake, Columbia, Colvin, Eddy, Freeborn, Gates, Grandfield, Hillsdale, Lake Washington, Munster, New Rockford, Paradise, Pleasant Prairie, Rosefield, Sheldon, Superior, and Tiffany. The official newspaper of the county is the New Rockford Transcript.
